tests.name: Decompression Bomb / Huge Dimension Header Rejection
tests.description: Verifies that crafted image files claiming 100,000x100,000 pixels are rejected or fail safely
tests.evidence: HTTP 400: {"detail":"Corrupted or unreadable image stream: cannot identify image file <_io

tests.name: Malformed Compressed Body Rejection
tests.description: Verifies that malformed or compressed payloads missing JSON decoding are rejected

tests.name: Forged HMAC Signature Rejection
tests.description: Verifies constant-time HMAC check rejects forged signatures with HTTP 403

tests.name: Payload Tampering Detection
tests.description: Verifies that tampering with signed payload bytes invalidates cryptographic check (HTTP 403)

tests.name: Stale Request Clock Skew Rejection (>300s past)
tests.description: Verifies that requests with timestamps older than 300s tolerance window are rejected with HTTP 403

tests.name: Future Clock Skew Rejection (>300s future)
tests.description: Verifies that requests with timestamps too far in the future are rejected with HTTP 403

tests.name: Replay Attack Mitigation (Nonce Reuse)
tests.description: Verifies that identical nonces are tracked and rejected with HTTP 409 Conflict

tests.name: Signature Reuse Replay Mitigation
tests.description: Verifies that reused cryptographic signatures are cached and rejected with HTTP 409 Conflict

tests.name: Cross-User Job Status Snooping Isolation
tests.description: Verifies that user B cannot inspect status of jobs owned by user A (HTTP 403 Forbidden)

tests.name: Cross-User Job Cancellation Mitigation
tests.description: Verifies that user B cannot cancel jobs owned by user A (HTTP 403 Forbidden)

tests.name: MIME Spoofing: ELF Executable Rejection
tests.description: Verifies that binary executables starting with \x7fELF are rejected with HTTP 400

tests.name: MIME Spoofing: Windows PE/MZ Binary Rejection
tests.description: Verifies that Windows PE executables starting with MZ are rejected with HTTP 400

tests.name: MIME Spoofing: SVG Vector / XML Script Rejection
tests.description: Verifies that vector SVG files containing script tags are rejected with HTTP 400
tests.evidence: HTTP 400: {"detail":"SVG vector images not supported for 3D reconstruc

tests.name: MIME Spoofing: Shell Script Shebang Rejection
tests.description: Verifies that script files starting with #! are rejected with HTTP 400

tests.name: Corrupted Base64 Decoding Rejection
tests.description: Verifies that syntactically invalid base64 is rejected with HTTP 400

tests.name: Truncated Binary Header Rejection (<8 bytes)
tests.description: Verifies that sub-8-byte truncated image headers are rejected with HTTP 400

tests.name: Path Traversal Mitigation (Direct ../)
tests.description: Verifies that asset downloads containing ../ characters are rejected with HTTP 400 or 404

tests.name: URL-Encoded Path Traversal Mitigation (%2e%2e%2f)
tests.description: Verifies that URL-encoded traversal characters are rejected with HTTP 400 or 404

tests.name: User Concurrency Limit Enforcement (MAX_USER_CONCURRENCY=2)
tests.description: Verifies that users attempting > 2 concurrent active jobs receive HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
tests.evidence: Enforced in staging_worker.py: user_active >= MAX_USER_CONCURRENCY raises HTTP 429

tests.name: Oversized Payload Rejection (>25MB)
tests.description: Verifies that uploads exceeding 25MB are rejected with HTTP 413 Payload Too Large
tests.evidence: Enforced in staging_worker.py: len(raw_body) > MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES raises HTTP 413
